Interface IFleet

All Known Implementing Classes:
Fleet
public interface IFleet
Defines a collection of ships placed on a square Battleship board. Provides placement validation, ship lookup and fleet status operations.

  • Method Details

    • getShips

      java.util.List<IShip> getShips()
      Returns the ships currently in the fleet.
      Returns:
      the fleet's mutable list of ships

    • addShip

      boolean addShip(IShip s)
      Attempts to add a ship subject to fleet capacity and placement checks. The ship must fit inside the board and must not overlap or touch another ship, including diagonally.
      Parameters:
      s - the non-null ship to add
      Returns:
      true if the ship was added; false if a check failed

    • getShipsLike

      java.util.List<IShip> getShipsLike(java.lang.String category)
      Selects ships with the given category name, using case-sensitive matching.
      Parameters:
      category - the category to select
      Returns:
      a new list containing the matching ships

    • getFloatingShips

      java.util.List<IShip> getFloatingShips()
      Selects ships that still have at least one unhit position.
      Returns:
      a new list containing the ships still afloat

    • shipAt

      IShip shipAt(IPosition pos)
      Finds the first ship occupying the supplied coordinates.
      Parameters:
      pos - the non-null position to inspect
      Returns:
      the occupying ship, or null if no ship occupies the position

    • printStatus

      void printStatus()
      Prints all ships, the ships still afloat and the ships in each category.
